title.zh: TikTok's Parent Company Just Borrowed $30 Billion to Go All-In on AI
title.en: TikTok's Parent Company Just Borrowed $30 Billion to Go All-In on AI

current_state.zh: ByteDance secured a $29.6 billion loan from nearly 30 banks to fund AI projects mainly outside China, increasing the facility from its initial $20 billion target.
